message.content: {"ranking": [{"id": "patch_4366b56c71e4", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 9435, "mechanism": "In STATE_TRANSFER_OUT CONTRACT branch the `cycle_count_reg == CYCLE_COUNT-1` predicate is guarded by `!output_axis_tready_int`, preventing `cycle_count_next` from advancing when the output side is back-pressured. This keeps the output pipeline from emitting the extra beat that produced the spurious tvalid at cycle 9."}, {"id": "patch_31ff37e82a23", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 10177, "mechanism": "In the EXPAND branch of STATE_TRANSFER_OUT the transition gate is qualified with `!output_axis_tready_int`, so the FSM cannot advance to the next input word until the output channel accepts the current byte. This stops the premature valid that appeared at cycle 9."}, {"id": "patch_7936cc858aae", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 8922, "mechanism": "In STATE_TRANSFER_IN the input capture is qualified with `output_axis_tready_int`, ensuring new input words are only absorbed when the output path is ready to drain them. This prevents the pipeline from over-filling and generating an extra tvalid at cycle 9."}, {"id": "patch_7123361951d8", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 10177, "mechanism": "Symmetrically to patch_31ff37e82a23 but for the CONTRACT direction: the EXPAND_BUS predicate is gated by `!input_axis_tlast`, avoiding a state transition that would otherwise release an additional output beat when the input frame has already terminated."}, {"id": "patch_4f3a96077aa5", "failure_port": "input_axis_tready", "source_line": 4599, "mechanism": "The handshake_reset_gate makes `input_axis_tready_reg` conditional on `!rst`, eliminating a reset-cycle readiness pulse that the trace expects to stay low at cycle 8."}, {"id": "patch_e805e9a3d4c9", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 8922, "mechanism": "Qualifies the STATE_TRANSFER_IN input capture with `!input_axis_tlast`, so a final input word does not trigger an extra output cycle that manifested as the unexpected tvalid at cycle 9."}, {"id": "patch_759e593ce41e", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 9435, "mechanism": "Guards the CONTRACT branch completion test with `!input_axis_tvalid`, preventing a still-valid input stream from extending the output sequence past the frame boundary and causing the cycle-9 tvalid."}, {"id": "patch_f007f011176d", "failure_port": "output_axis_tvalid", "source_line": 7213, "mechanism": "In the EXPAND branch of STATE_IDLE the input acceptance is qualified with `!output_axis_tready_int`, so a new input word is not latched while the output side is still holding the previous byte, avoiding the surplus tvalid at cycle 9."}], "explanation": "The three mismatches (input_axis_tready cycle 8, output_axis_tlast cycle 8, output_axis_tvalid cycle 9) all stem from the adapter emitting one extra output beat after the input frame has ended.  Patches that gate FSM progress on the complementary ready/valid/last signals (patch_4366b56c71e4, patch_31ff37e82a23, patch_7936cc858aae, patch_7123361951d8, patch_e805e9a3d4c9, patch_759e593ce41e, patch_f007f011176d) directly suppress that extra beat.  The reset gate patch_4f3a96077aa5 independently corrects the early tready pulse at cycle 8.  Candidates are ranked by how precisely their cited line and mechanism account for the observed failing ports."}
